summary.root_cause_text: The ops config change of payment_provider_url from internal://payments-v1 to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration) made the worker process orders without recording payments. The failure was silent.
recommended: Before retrying the payments-v2 migration, find out why it does not record payments and test it in staging.
Add an alert on the payment gap and make the payment provider log at WARNING when it fails.
